parts.html: Interior design studio DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed an interior design project for a 58 m² apartment in Bratislava. The project covered the full cycle of work: technical documentation, custom furniture, decorating, and a turnkey renovation.

The design covers the living room, bedroom, kitchen with built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, and bathroom. Built-in wardrobes, shelving, and storage systems were custom-designed for each area.
Within 58 m², the layout and furniture were planned to provide ample storage while keeping the interior open and airy.
Before the renovation, the client received a detailed cost estimate covering construction and finishing work, materials, furniture, and appliances.
The gallery features photorealistic 3D visualizations of the apartment.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN provides interior design for apartments and private houses, develops custom furniture, and delivers comprehensive turnkey renovation projects in Bratislava and other cities in Slovakia.
